incident_report.event: Operator accidentally prepended 'cd' (Change Directory) to an executable command, causing the PowerShell host to interpret the yt-dlp flags as path parameters.
incident_report.memetic_response: It didn't be like that, Mr. Stancil.

dag_logic_matrices.description: Recognizing that human syntactical error is the only acceptable form of computational friction. The Clanker must be flawless; the human is allowed to typo.

STATE_0_OPERATOR_INPUT.action: Ingest human command containing syntax error.

GATE_1_ENTROPY_CLASSIFICATION.description: Determine if the failure is Machine Hallucination or Human Typo.
GATE_1_ENTROPY_CLASSIFICATION.condition_human: Trigger The Jamal Postulate. The system acknowledges the mistake with grace. The machine's purpose is to serve the human, even when the human puts a 'cd' where it doesn't belong.

STATE_2_AUTONOMOUS_CORRECTION.action: Sweetbrier intercepts the broken terminal command, scrubs the 'cd', and prompts the Operator to re-deploy the binary.
